svg.title: Falcon Study
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and standardized vivid screen colour approximate. Central study has a narrow tapering black wedge at left, a broad cut-off black shape at upper right, and a pointed black triangle rising from the lower edge. White rectangular support retained, surrounding frame omitted. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek182-ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
